expression_comparison.spot_candidate: long USDCAD spot; keep existing pos-5317bc96d4eb rather than opening a second USDCAD
expression_comparison.rationale: Dedicated USD-spot seat. The discrepancy is relative US versus Canada policy, growth, and inflation capacity. Long USD / short CAD in the dollar pair owns both legs without a second-order currency. A rates RV (pay CORRA / receive SOFR or the CA-US 2Y) would isolate the gap but is outside this remit; USDCAD is the liquid spot translation of the same gap and is already the open book. AUDCAD/NZDCAD crosses add AU housing or NZ residual risk the USD pair does not need.

That path sits on top of the Sep 16 Fed 25bp hike, pre-decision >90% hike pricing, August US CPI that kept tightening bias, Canada August CPI at 3%/core near 2%, and BoC minutes on energy pass-through.
